# CodeGuru

> A developer blog covering algorithms, cloud messaging, and modern programming languages with practical tutorials and solutions.

CodeGuru provides in-depth technical content on graph algorithms, Leetcode problem-solving, cloud platforms (Azure, Kafka), and programming languages including JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, and Java. The site serves developers preparing for interviews and seeking to master complex architectural patterns.

## Key Topics

- Graph Algorithms
- Depth-First Search (DFS)
- Leetcode Solutions
- Kafka
- Azure Service Bus
- Backtracking
- Data Structures
- Path Finding
- Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAG)
- JavaScript
- C#
- Interview Preparation
- Cloud Messaging
- Algorithm Design
- Code Refactoring

## Algorithm & Data Structure Tutorials

- [All Paths From Source To Target - Leetcode Solution](https://www.codeguru.co.in/2024/11/all-paths-from-source-to-target.html): Leetcode graph theory solution using DFS for finding paths in directed acyclic graphs
- [Counting the Number of Islands in a 2D Grid: An Efficient Depth-First Search](https://www.codeguru.co.in/2024/10/counting-number-of-islands-in-2d-grid.html): DFS algorithm tutorial solving island counting problem in 2D grids with JavaScript
- [Expression Add Operators - In-Depth Explanation](https://www.codeguru.co.in/2024/10/expression-add-operators-in-depth.html): In-depth Leetcode solution using backtracking and memoization for expression evaluation

## Cloud Messaging & Architecture

- [Key Kafka Features Every Developer Should Know](https://www.codeguru.co.in/2024/10/key-kafka-features-every-developer.html): Guide to essential Kafka features, Streams API, Connect, and architecture for developers
- [Azure Service Bus messaging - Advanced Features](https://www.codeguru.co.in/2024/10/azure-service-bus-messaging-advanced.html): Tutorial on Azure Service Bus advanced features including sessions, deferral, and patterns

## Language-Specific Programming

- [Convert FileStream to base64 string in C#](https://www.codeguru.co.in/2021/05/convert-filestream-to-base64-string-in-c.html): C# tutorial on converting FileStream to base64 encoding with code examples

## Developer Tools & Productivity

- [Vscode Rename Or Change All Instances Of a Variable Everywhere](https://www.codeguru.co.in/2020/04/vscode-rename-all-instances-of-variable.html): Visual Studio Code productivity guide for efficient variable renaming and refactoring

## Core
